messages.subject: For Mohamed Hassan Alsuwaidi | Strategic investment, infrastructure and government partnerships
messages.body:
Dear ADQ Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before H.E. Mohamed Hassan Alsuwaidi, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer.

ADQ's strategic portfolio across infrastructure, logistics, energy and industrial development depends on disciplined alignment across governments, operating companies and long-term investment priorities. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market execution might support ADQ's international or portfolio priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to ADQ.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
